categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: The standard 3-way matching process where the goods receipt (GR) is recorded before the invoice receipt (IR). Advances 'Preserve value-matching control integrity' and is measured against the 'Time to clearance, 3-way after GR (days)' indicator.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=5. Supported by frequent variants like V0001 where Record Goods Receipt precedes Record Invoice Receipt.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: An alternative 3-way matching process where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt occurs. Helps 'Maximize working-capital efficiency' and is measured against 'Time to clearance, 3-way before GR (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=6. Observed in variants such as V0007 where Vendor creates invoice and Record Invoice Receipt occur prior to Record Goods Receipt.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: A simplified matching process where no goods receipt is required, lowering procurement overhead. Measured against the 'Time to clearance, 2-way match (days)' indicator.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=7. Represented by low length and low duration cases where invoicing proceeds directly to clearance.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Resolution of the purchase order via consignment consumption, reducing matching overhead. Measured against exception and clearance indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13. Reflected in specialized service and consumption-based flows like V0064.
